report:
Reviewed the complete explicit_incompleteness claim, its ordinary TcxDb implementation association and the sole TODO test. The requirement covers missing, unsupported and conservatively incomplete external facts: these must not be replaced by guessed facts, successful interfaces or exhaustive negative conclusions. Captured metadata design and the linked architectural-foundations terminal-incompleteness rationale.

TcxDb inspection: semantic signature/value/candidate operations return Option, with default implementations returning None. RawTraitSignature/RawImplSignature/RawAssociatedTypeValue and item/candidate inventories carry completeness; function and ADT signatures distinguish ordinary completeness from const/deferred completeness. RawGenericDefault distinguishes Absent from Unsupported, preventing an unavailable default from masquerading as a required omitted argument. adt_is_always_sized returns Option<bool> and documents that false is not necessarily proof of unsizedness. These are explicit transport representations, not by themselves proof that all consumers preserve the statuses.

Captured consumer assessment: external_syms propagates missing signatures/values through Option, incomplete associated item enumeration as None, and missing impl/inherent candidate sources as complete=false rather than a complete empty list. Wrong candidate kinds reduce completeness. Trait/function/impl lowering preserves incomplete predicate/type information through solver eligibility or None. Partial function fallback types are accompanied by Unsupported eligibility and are not assessed as complete interfaces. apply_external_adt_signature rejects absent/incomplete declaration metadata and unsupported required defaults as MetadataUnavailable; supplied explicit arguments can legitimately avoid needing a declaration default. The captured cst type consumer emits an unavailable-metadata diagnostic and Ty::Error for this failure. Ordinary versus const/deferred flags remain distinct: a complete ordinary operation does not imply that deferred const semantics are supported.

Captured clauses::assemble_candidates treats absent/ineligible trait signatures, incomplete source inventories, unavailable impl signatures and ineligible headers as incomplete search. Captured method selection sets unknown for missing or ineligible trait facts and selects a unique candidate only when unknown is false; incomplete inherent discovery emits an explicit diagnostic instead of falling through as an exhaustive miss. Captured candidate merging gates exhaustive No and ordinary unique-answer selection on complete discovery and passes an unconstrained possible branch to hint merging when discovery is incomplete. An independently established unconditional Proven answer can still win: this is an existing proof, not success fabricated from missing metadata. A Type output does not receive that exception. The captured hint merger represents incomplete possibilities conservatively rather than narrowing to only known candidates.

Test adequacy is explicitly deferred: todo::metadata_explicit_incompleteness contains no assertions and asks for provider fixtures returning missing, unsupported and incomplete values at every semantic boundary, caller diagnostics/completeness checks, and solver evidence excluding false Yes/No. This is the needed all-boundary matrix; source inspection of the representative status propagation above does not replace it. Completing that matrix requires controllable provider facts and source-driven calls through each consumer, with both incomplete-empty and incomplete-nonempty discovery, unsupported defaults/types/predicates, ordinary/deferred distinctions, and legitimate independent proof cases. Auxiliary naming/module APIs have different non-Option return shapes; this report does not infer exhaustive absence/error guarantees for them merely from the semantic Option APIs. Their missing-provider behavior belongs in the stated full-boundary verification work. No ordinary test or runtime coverage is claimed for the current associated test set.

Commands executed: fresh review start with coordinator instructions, exact claim/test/source inspection, review read captures for metadata design/RFD, external lowering, type diagnostic consumer, candidate assembly, method selection and result/hint merging. A read attempted for a nonexistent hints.rs failed; the actual anti_unify.rs helper was subsequently captured. No tests or build executed by this reviewer; central suites remain separate evidence. No source edits or new reproduced behavioral defect. No requested edits; the broad provider/consumer verification TODO remains explicitly deferred.
